raw_response:
The issuer appears highly leveraged, with liabilities consuming about 96% of assets and equity only ~3.6% of assets, while operating profitability is very thin (EBIT roughly 2% of revenue). Although liquidity is still adequate (current ratio 1.18) and retained earnings are positive, the weak earnings cushion against such a heavy liability load supports a deeply speculative rating rather than an investment-grade profile.

DECISION: B-
